findings.detail: Glossary drift: this namespace uses 'demonio'/'demonios', while the committed, shipped es relay.asks catalogue uses 'daemon' in error.reach_failed, error.no_reason and error.read_timeout; the W2 sibling cli.browser_help also uses 'daemon'. Neither the style guide nor glossary authorizes a daemon/demonio split. Current assigned values: cli.mobile_help.install: Instalar el demonio, la contraseña y el LaunchAgent | cli.mobile_help.status: Estado del demonio, control de acceso y sesiones activas | cli.mobile_help.daemon_action: {action, select, start{Iniciar} stop{Detener} restart{Reiniciar} other{{action}}} el demonio | cli.mobile_help.logs: Mostrar el final de los registros del demonio y de los runtimes | cli.mobile_help.devices_port: Puerto del demonio móvil (por defecto, el del propio demonio) | cli.mobile_help.serve: Ejecutar el demonio (en primer plano)
findings.remediation: Standardize on 'daemon'/'daemons' in these keys (and coordinate the adjacent W2 browser keys so the surface stays consistent). Keep all surrounding grammar and ICU bodies otherwise unchanged.
